abstract: Connect Zed, the Rust code editor with Agent Panel, Inline Assistant and edit prediction, to self-hosted and gateway model endpoints. Covers openai_compatible and anthropic_compatible providers for vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, LiteLLM and llama-swap, model-name and context mapping, key handling, tool calling, reasoning and streaming caveats, built-in local providers, self-hosted edit prediction, update, and troubleshooting, with settings templates.
